facts.fact: Kenya, South Sudan, Uganda and Rwanda ministers resolved at the Connected Africa Summit in Nairobi to work towards a jointly owned regional communication and broadcasting satellite, starting with a feasibility study funded by the four states; the report gives no day for the meeting, so the report date is used.
facts.system: Northern Corridor Regional Communication and Broadcasting Satellite Initiative

facts.fact: The report states that in July 2025 TTCL and Kenya's ICTA launched and implemented a terrestrial fibre link connecting Dar es Salaam to Mombasa.
facts.system: TTCL-ICTA Dar es Salaam-Mombasa terrestrial fibre link

facts.fact: The report states that in May 2025 Bayobab completed a fibre optic network linking Mombasa in Kenya to Kampala in Uganda.
